metadata.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
metadata.authors: Yaron Lipman, Ricky T. Q. Chen, Heli Ben-Hamu, Maximilian Nickel, Matt Le

nodes.name: Probability density path
nodes.statement: A time-dependent probability density function $p:[0,1]\times \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}_{>0}$ satisfying $\int p_t(x)dx = 1$ for all $t \in [0,1]$.
nodes.statement_clean: A time-indexed family of probability densities on $\mathbb{R}^d$.

nodes.name: Time-dependent vector field
nodes.statement: A map $v:[0,1]\times \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}^d$ that assigns a velocity vector $v_t(x)$ to each point $x$ at each time $t$.

nodes.name: Flow
nodes.statement: A diffeomorphic map $\phi:[0,1]\times \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}^d$ defined by the ODE $\frac{d}{dt}\phi_t(x) = v_t(\phi_t(x))$ with $\phi_0(x) = x$.

nodes.name: Continuous Normalizing Flow (CNF)
nodes.statement: A deep parametric model of the flow $\phi_t$ obtained by modeling the vector field with a neural network $v_t(x;\theta)$ with parameters $\theta \in \mathbb{R}^p$.

nodes.name: Push-forward
nodes.statement: $[\phi_t]_* p_0(x) = p_0(\phi_t^{-1}(x))\det\left[\frac{\partial \phi_t^{-1}}{\partial x}(x)\right]$; a vector field $v_t$ is said to generate $p_t$ if its flow satisfies $p_t = [\phi_t]_* p_0$.

nodes.name: Conditional probability path
nodes.statement: A density $p_t(x|x_1)$ for each data sample $x_1$ such that $p_0(x|x_1) = p(x)$ and $p_1(x|x_1)$ is concentrated around $x_1$, e.g. $p_1(x|x_1)=\mathcal{N}(x|x_1,\sigma^2 I)$.

nodes.name: Marginal probability path
nodes.statement: $p_t(x) = \int p_t(x|x_1) q(x_1) dx_1$, the mixture of conditional probability paths over the data distribution.

nodes.name: Marginal vector field
nodes.statement: $u_t(x) = \int u_t(x|x_1) \frac{p_t(x|x_1)q(x_1)}{p_t(x)} dx_1$, the aggregation of conditional vector fields weighted by the posterior over $x_1$.

nodes.name: Continuity equation
nodes.statement: PDE $\frac{d}{dt}p_t(x) + \mathrm{div}(p_t(x) v_t(x)) = 0$ providing necessary and sufficient condition that $v_t$ generates $p_t$.

nodes.name: Gaussian conditional probability path
nodes.statement: $p_t(x|x_1) = \mathcal{N}(x|\mu_t(x_1), \sigma_t(x_1)^2 I)$ with $\mu_0=0,\sigma_0=1$ and $\mu_1(x_1)=x_1,\sigma_1(x_1)=\sigma_{\min}$.

nodes.name: OT displacement interpolant
nodes.statement: $p_t = [(1-t)\mathrm{id} + t\psi]_\star p_0$ where $\psi$ is the OT map pushing $p_0$ to $p_1$; for two Gaussians (first standard) the displacement map takes the form $\psi_t(x)=(1-(1-\sigma_{\min})t)x + tx_1$.
nodes.origin_citation: McCann 1997, A convexity principle for interacting gases

nodes.name: Flow ODE
nodes.statement: $\frac{d}{dt}\phi_t(x) = v_t(\phi_t(x)),\ \phi_0(x)=x$.

nodes.name: Flow Matching (FM) objective
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{t,p_t(x)}\|v_t(x) - u_t(x)\|^2$, with $t \sim \mathcal{U}[0,1]$, $x \sim p_t(x)$.

nodes.name: Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) objective
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CFM}}(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{t,q(x_1),p_t(x|x_1)} \|v_t(x) - u_t(x|x_1)\|^2$.

nodes.name: OT-CFM closed form loss
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CFM}}(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{t,q(x_1),p(x_0)}\|v_t(\psi_t(x_0)) - (x_1 - (1-\sigma_{\min})x_0)\|^2$.

nodes.name: Marginal vector field generates marginal probability path
nodes.statement: Given vector fields $u_t(x|x_1)$ that generate conditional paths $p_t(x|x_1)$, for any $q(x_1)$ the marginal vector field $u_t$ in (3) generates the marginal path $p_t$ in (2); i.e. $u_t,p_t$ satisfy the continuity equation.
nodes.statement_clean: The posterior-weighted average of conditional vector fields generates the corresponding mixture probability path.
assumptions: Conditional vector fields $u_t(x|x_1)$ generate conditional probability paths $p_t(x|x_1)$
Regularity conditions of Leibniz rule for exchanging integration and differentiation
conclusions: The marginal vector field $u_t(x) = \int u_t(x|x_1) \frac{p_t(x|x_1)q(x_1)}{p_t(x)} dx_1$ generates $p_t(x) = \int p_t(x|x_1)q(x_1) dx_1$

nodes.name: FM and CFM gradients coincide
nodes.statement: Assuming $p_t(x)>0$ for all $x \in \mathbb{R}^d, t \in [0,1]$, then up to a constant independent of $\theta$, $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CFM}}$ and $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}$ are equal; hence $\nabla_\theta \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}(\theta) = \nabla_\theta \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CFM}}(\theta)$.
nodes.statement_clean: The tractable per-sample CFM loss has the same gradients with respect to $\theta$ as the intractable FM loss.

nodes.name: Unique vector field of Gaussian flow
nodes.statement: Let $p_t(x|x_1)$ be a Gaussian path $\mathcal{N}(x|\mu_t(x_1),\sigma_t(x_1)^2 I)$ and $\psi_t(x) = \sigma_t(x_1)x + \mu_t(x_1)$. Then the unique vector field defining $\psi_t$ has the form $u_t(x|x_1) = \frac{\sigma'_t(x_1)}{\sigma_t(x_1)}(x-\mu_t(x_1)) + \mu'_t(x_1)$.
nodes.statement_clean: Closed-form generating vector field for the canonical affine flow of a Gaussian conditional path.

nodes.name: Time-reversal of generating vector field
nodes.statement: If $u_t$ generates $p_t$, then $\tilde{u}_t(x) = -u_{1-t}(x)$ generates $\tilde{p}_t(x) = p_{1-t}(x)$ when initialized at $\tilde{p}_0(x) = p_1(x)$.
conclusions: $\tilde{u}_t(x) = -u_{1-t}(x)$ generates the time-reversed path $\tilde{p}_t(x) = p_{1-t}(x)$ initialized at $\tilde{p}_0 = p_1$

nodes.name: Diffusion conditional VF coincides with Probability Flow ODE
nodes.statement: The conditional vector fields derived from Theorem 3 for VE and VP Gaussian paths coincide with the vector field of the deterministic Probability Flow ODE of Song et al. (2020).
assumptions: VE path $p_t(x|x_1)=\mathcal{N}(x|x_1,\sigma_{1-t}^2 I)$ or VP path $p_t(x|x_1)=\mathcal{N}(x|\alpha_{1-t}x_1,(1-\alpha_{1-t}^2)I)$
conclusions: Resulting $u_t(x|x_1)$ from Theorem 3 equals the Probability Flow ODE VF in Song et al. 2020 eq. 13

nodes.name: OT conditional flow as displacement map
nodes.statement: For $\mu_t(x)=tx_1$ and $\sigma_t(x)=1-(1-\sigma_{\min})t$, the conditional flow $\psi_t(x)=(1-(1-\sigma_{\min})t)x + tx_1$ is the OT displacement map between the Gaussians $p_0(x|x_1)$ and $p_1(x|x_1)$.
assumptions: Linear-in-$t$ mean and std with boundary conditions
$p_0$ and $p_1$ both Gaussian with first being standard
conclusions: $\psi_t$ is the OT (Wasserstein-2) displacement map between $p_0(x|x_1)$ and $p_1(x|x_1)$
Particles travel in straight lines at constant speed

nodes.name: Flow Matching (FM) / Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) training
nodes.statement: Iterative training procedure that regresses a neural vector field $v_t(x;\theta)$ onto the conditional vector field $u_t(x|x_1)$ via SGD on the CFM loss.
input: Choice of conditional probability path $p_t(x|x_1)$ and vector field $u_t(x|x_1)$
output: Trained CNF vector field $v_t(x;\theta)$ approximating the marginal $u_t(x)$ that generates $p_t \approx q$ at $t=1$

nodes.name: CNF sampling via ODE solver
nodes.statement: Draw $x_0 \sim \mathcal{N}(0,I)$ then compute $\phi_1(x_0)$ by solving the flow ODE with the trained $v_t$ on $t \in [0,1]$ using an off-the-shelf ODE solver (\texttt{dopri5} or fixed-step midpoint).

nodes.name: Hutchinson trace estimator for CNF log-likelihood
nodes.statement: Replace the divergence in the change-of-variable ODE with the unbiased Hutchinson estimator $z^T D v_t(\phi_t(x)) z$ where $\mathbb{E} zz^T = I$, and solve in reverse to obtain an unbiased estimator of $\log p_1(x_1)$.

nodes.name: Score Matching (SM) baseline
nodes.statement: Train a score network $s_t(x)$ via $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{SM}} = \mathbb{E}\, \lambda(t)\|s_t(x) - \nabla \log p_t(x|x_1)\|^2$; baseline against FM.

nodes.name: DDPM (Noise Matching) baseline
nodes.statement: Train a noise network $\epsilon_t(x)$ via $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{NM}} = \mathbb{E}\,\|\epsilon_t(\sigma_t(x_1)x_0+\mu_t(x_1)) - x_0\|^2$; baseline against FM.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 1 (marginal VF)
nodes.statement: Verify the continuity equation for the marginal $(p_t,u_t)$ by exchanging differentiation and integration and using that conditional $u_t(\cdot|x_1)$ generates $p_t(\cdot|x_1)$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 2 (FM=CFM gradients)
nodes.statement: Expand the squared norms, identify $\theta$-independent terms, and use Fubini's theorem with the marginal definition of $p_t$ to show $\mathbb{E}_{p_t(x)}\langle v_t,u_t\rangle = \mathbb{E}_{q(x_1),p_t(x|x_1)}\langle v_t,u_t(\cdot|x_1)\rangle$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 3 (Gaussian VF)
nodes.statement: Use $\frac{d}{dt}\psi_t(x) = w_t(\psi_t(x))$, invert $\psi_t$, differentiate in $t$, and combine to solve for $w_t$.

nodes.name: Proof of time-reversal lemma
nodes.statement: Apply the continuity equation to $\tilde{p}_t(x) = p_{1-t}(x)$ and observe $-u_{1-t}$ produces the same divergence equation.

nodes.name: Differentiate marginal under integral
nodes.statement: Compute $\frac{d}{dt} p_t(x) = \int \frac{d}{dt} p_t(x|x_1) q(x_1) dx_1$ by exchanging differentiation and integration (Leibniz).

nodes.name: Apply conditional continuity equation
nodes.statement: Use that $u_t(\cdot|x_1)$ generates $p_t(\cdot|x_1)$ to substitute $\frac{d}{dt} p_t(x|x_1) = -\mathrm{div}(u_t(x|x_1)p_t(x|x_1))$.

nodes.name: Pull divergence out and identify marginal VF
nodes.statement: Exchange the $x_1$-integral with $\mathrm{div}$ to obtain $-\mathrm{div}(u_t(x) p_t(x))$ using the definition (3) of the marginal $u_t$, completing the continuity equation for $(p_t,u_t)$.

nodes.name: Bilinear expansion of the squared norms
nodes.statement: $\|v_t-u_t\|^2 = \|v_t\|^2 - 2\langle v_t,u_t\rangle + \|u_t\|^2$ and similarly for $\|v_t-u_t(\cdot|x_1)\|^2$.

nodes.name: Marginal vs conditional norm of $v_t$
nodes.statement: Show $\mathbb{E}_{p_t(x)} \|v_t(x)\|^2 = \mathbb{E}_{q(x_1),p_t(x|x_1)} \|v_t(x)\|^2$ using $p_t = \int p_t(\cdot|x_1)q(x_1) dx_1$ and Fubini.

nodes.name: Inner-product identity via marginal $u_t$
nodes.statement: $\mathbb{E}_{p_t(x)}\langle v_t(x),u_t(x)\rangle = \mathbb{E}_{q(x_1),p_t(x|x_1)}\langle v_t(x),u_t(x|x_1)\rangle$ using the definition of marginal $u_t$ and exchanging integration order.

nodes.name: Conclude equality of objectives up to $\theta$-constant
nodes.statement: Combine the identities; the $\|u_t\|^2$ and $\|u_t(\cdot|x_1)\|^2$ terms are independent of $\theta$, so $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}$ and $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CFM}}$ differ by a $\theta$-independent constant; gradients agree.

nodes.name: Set up flow ODE for $w_t$
nodes.statement: Let $w_t(x) := u_t(x|x_1)$. From the basic ODE $\frac{d}{dt}\psi_t(x) = w_t(\psi_t(x))$ substitute $x = \psi_t^{-1}(y)$ to get $\psi'_t(\psi_t^{-1}(y)) = w_t(y)$.

nodes.name: Invert the affine flow
nodes.statement: Compute $\psi_t^{-1}(y) = \frac{y - \mu_t(x_1)}{\sigma_t(x_1)}$ and $\psi'_t(x) = \sigma'_t(x_1)x + \mu'_t(x_1)$.

nodes.name: Substitute and obtain closed-form $u_t(x|x_1)$
nodes.statement: Plug the inverse and derivative into $\psi'_t(\psi_t^{-1}(y)) = w_t(y)$ to get $w_t(y) = \frac{\sigma'_t(x_1)}{\sigma_t(x_1)}(y - \mu_t(x_1)) + \mu'_t(x_1)$.

nodes.name: Differentiate $\tilde p_t = p_{1-t}$
nodes.statement: $\frac{d}{dt}\tilde p_t(x) = -p'_{1-t}(x)$.

nodes.name: Apply continuity equation for $p_t$
nodes.statement: $-p'_{1-t}(x) = \mathrm{div}(p_{1-t}(x) u_{1-t}(x)) = -\mathrm{div}(\tilde p_t(x) (-u_{1-t}(x)))$, so $\tilde u_t(x) = -u_{1-t}(x)$ generates $\tilde p_t$.

nodes.name: Sample $t,x_1,x$
nodes.statement: Sample $t \sim \mathcal{U}[0,1]$, $x_1 \sim q(x_1)$, $x \sim p_t(x|x_1)$ (e.g. for Gaussian path: $x_0 \sim \mathcal{N}(0,I)$ and $x = \psi_t(x_0) = \sigma_t(x_1) x_0 + \mu_t(x_1)$).

nodes.name: Compute conditional VF target
nodes.statement: Evaluate $u_t(x|x_1) = \frac{\sigma'_t(x_1)}{\sigma_t(x_1)}(x-\mu_t(x_1)) + \mu'_t(x_1)$ (Theorem 3); for OT path simplify to target $x_1 - (1-\sigma_{\min})x_0$.

nodes.name: Compute CFM loss and gradient
nodes.statement: Evaluate $\|v_t(x;\theta) - u_t(x|x_1)\|^2$ and back-propagate to obtain $\nabla_\theta \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CFM}}$.

nodes.name: Adam parameter update (loop)
nodes.statement: Apply Adam step on $\theta$; repeat the sample/loss/update cycle for $N$ iterations until convergence.

nodes.name: Draw initial noise
nodes.statement: Sample $x_0 \sim \mathcal{N}(0,I)$.

nodes.name: Integrate flow ODE
nodes.statement: Solve $\frac{d}{dt}\phi_t(x_0) = v_t(\phi_t(x_0);\theta)$ on $t \in [0,1]$ with an ODE solver (e.g. \texttt{dopri5} with atol/rtol $=10^{-5}$, or fixed-step midpoint).

nodes.name: Return sample
nodes.statement: Return $x_1 = \phi_1(x_0)$.

nodes.name: Set up reverse-time augmented ODE
nodes.statement: Initialize at $s=0$ with $\phi_1(x) = x_1$, $\tilde f(1) = 0$; integrate $\frac{d}{ds}[\phi_{1-s}, \tilde f(1-s)] = [-v_{1-s}(\phi_{1-s}), z^T D v_{1-s}(\phi_{1-s}) z]$ for $s \in [0,1]$.

nodes.name: Return unbiased log-likelihood estimate
nodes.statement: Return $\log p_0(x_0) - \tilde f(0)$ as an unbiased estimator of $\log p_1(x_1)$.

nodes.name: Variance Exploding (VE) diffusion path
nodes.statement: Reversed VE path $p_t(x|x_1) = \mathcal{N}(x | x_1, \sigma_{1-t}^2 I)$ with $\sigma_t$ increasing, $\sigma_0=0, \sigma_1\gg 1$; substituting in Theorem 3 gives $u_t(x|x_1) = -\frac{\sigma'_{1-t}}{\sigma_{1-t}}(x-x_1)$.

nodes.name: Variance Preserving (VP) diffusion path
nodes.statement: $p_t(x|x_1) = \mathcal{N}(x | \alpha_{1-t} x_1, (1-\alpha_{1-t}^2)I)$ with $\alpha_t = e^{-T(t)/2}$, $T(t)=\int_0^t \beta(s)ds$; gives $u_t(x|x_1) = -\frac{T'(1-t)}{2}\frac{e^{-T(1-t)}x - e^{-T(1-t)/2}x_1}{1 - e^{-T(1-t)}}$.

nodes.name: Optimal Transport conditional path
nodes.statement: $\mu_t(x)=tx_1$, $\sigma_t(x)=1-(1-\sigma_{\min})t$, giving $u_t(x|x_1) = \frac{x_1 - (1-\sigma_{\min})x}{1-(1-\sigma_{\min})t}$ and conditional flow $\psi_t(x) = (1-(1-\sigma_{\min})t)x + tx_1$ with constant-direction VF and straight-line trajectories.

nodes.name: 2D checkerboard generative model
nodes.statement: CNFs trained with FM-OT, FM-Diffusion, and SM-Diffusion on a 2D checkerboard distribution; FM-OT introduces the checkerboard pattern earlier and is more efficient at low NFE.

nodes.name: Unconditional ImageNet 32/64/128 generation
nodes.statement: Train CNFs with FM-OT, FM-Diffusion, SM, ScoreFlow, DDPM on ImageNet 32, 64, 128 (and CIFAR-10); FM-OT consistently obtains best NLL/FID/NFE; ImageNet-128 reaches FID 20.9 and BPD 2.90.

nodes.name: Conditional super-resolution 64$\to$256
nodes.statement: Apply Flow Matching with OT path to upsample 64$\times$64 ImageNet images to 256$\times$256; FM-OT achieves FID 3.4 and IS 200.8, outperforming SR3 in FID/IS while matching PSNR/SSIM.

nodes.name: OT VF has constant direction in time
nodes.statement: The OT conditional VF can be written as $u_t(x|x_1) = g(t)h(x|x_1)$, hence has a constant direction across $t$, in contrast to diffusion VFs whose directions vary with $t$.

nodes.name: Diffusion paths do not reach true noise in finite time
nodes.statement: Diffusion-derived paths only approach a Gaussian as $t \to 0$ and do not exactly reach noise in finite time; the FM construction lets us directly set $\mu_t,\sigma_t$ with full path control.

nodes.name: Marginal VF need not be optimal transport
nodes.statement: Even though each conditional flow is the OT displacement map between Gaussians, the resulting marginal VF is not in general the OT solution between $p_0$ and $q$.

nodes.name: Theorem 1 derivable from Diffusion Mixture Representation
nodes.statement: Theorem 1 can also be derived from the Diffusion Mixture Representation Theorem of Peluchetti (2021), which gives marginal drift/diffusion coefficients of mixed diffusion SDEs.

nodes.name: Simulation-free CNF training
nodes.statement: Train a CNF $v_t(x;\theta)$ to push a simple prior $p_0$ to a target $p_1 \approx q$ at $t=1$ without ODE simulation during training, scaling to high-dimensional image distributions.
